verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel is an immigration law firm offering legal services such as consultations, visa applications and compliance work. It is not a software product with a UI whose functions could be exposed through an API, so API–UI parity is the wrong axis for this kind of product. The probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, which is consistent with this, and no evidence shows any API or client-facing software that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
